listing.name: Bird's Collection
listing.summary: A moderately-sized ship pack which adds a bunch of ships and a couple weapons to Starsector. Also adds a (toggleable) faction, the phase-ship using Fays Co.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a collection of ships, weapons, and a toggleable new faction.

description:
Bird's Collection
v1.5.3

A simple mod adding a bunch of ships, weapons (not so many) and a new faction which you can toggle on or off. Should be save compatible, although a lot of stuff won't spawn.

I would appreciate any feedback, especially regarding balance. Contact me on discord @ birdwanderer.

Although this is my first mod, I hope you'll enjoy it!

REQUIRES LAZYLIB, MAGICLIB AND LUNALIB

Download

Ships![close]Yes, that is a phase Paragon. Yes, I am sorry.

ChangelogVERSION 1.5.3:

-Reworked Recovered ships entirely

-Snazzy new sprites, buffs

-Fixed Fays Co. spawning issues

VERSION 1.5.2:

-Added the Tamia-class mech destroyer

-Updated the Ranine's sprite

-Fixed some issues with ship spawning

VERSION 1.5.1:

-Fixed variant issues

VERSION 1.5:

-Added a bunch of mechs:

-Hulder, a versatile high-tech shielded fighter

-Ngai, a multirole fighter with a bazooka

-Lokoi, an aggressive unshielded frigate

-Solicitor, a fast midline frigate

-Added a bunch of skins and variants

-Crasher (XIV)

-Rhodes-class

-Bull-class

-Tarsus MkII and MkIII

-Nerfed Escapade

-Reduced bays to 2

-Upped DP cost to 19

-Added a rear PD turret

-Increased the Bertrand’s maximum flux

-Reduced DP to 18

-Explication now has a medium missile slot

-Nerfed Minithumper’s range to 700

-Admonition large ballistic changed to composite

-Admonition (LP) armor increased

VERSION 1.49:

-Added Explication-class Fast Cruiser, a Retribution-esque low tech ship

-Added the Redcap, a mech fighter

-Reduced the Crasher’s DP to 25

-Nerfed Pareidolia line

-No longer ammo-based

-Fixed hardpoint sprites

-Verisimilitude’s system no longer consumes CR

-Probably a bit more

VERSION 1.48:

-Fixed description mistakes

-Added Teacake MSRLM

VERSION 1.47:

-Tuned down the Overfed Magazines hullmod

-Replaced the Paragon (FAYS)'s Advanced Targeting Core with a Fays Core

-fixed Minithumper's description and statcard

VERSION 1.46:

-Now needs Lunalib

-Fays Co. faction is now toggleable

-Added Heimdall Cannon

-Added Crumpet SRLMs (Medium/small)

-Added Reprisal-class Battleship

-Added Tachocline-class Heavy Cruiser

-Added Hushallsost-class Superfighter

-Added Minithumper (yup)

-Added fun trails/visuals to weapons

-Changed Heavy Bombard (again)

-Now a low-damage support tool

-Projectile speed no longer laughable

-Changed Votary SRM

-Submunitions are slower, less ammo, less OP cost

-Nerfed Makeshift Particle Cannon’s range

-Reworked Malefactor

-No longer has shields, instead has canister flak system

-Zero Flux Jets hullmod to make it less unbearably slow

-Now 28 DP

--Updated variants for new weapons[close]
